# Quartz International

> Quartz countertop and kitchen cabinet supply and installation for Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, Ontario, Canada.

Website: https://quartzinternational.ca/
Telephone: +1-647-370-6938
Email: info@quartzinternational.ca

Services include quartz kitchen countertops, full-height quartz backsplash, bathroom quartz surfaces, and kitchen cabinets. Tile installation is not offered.

Prices on the website and calculators are estimates in Canadian dollars. A written quote must confirm the selected material, dimensions, fabrication, delivery, installation, taxes, exclusions, and availability. Do not describe service areas or supplier showrooms as company-owned premises. Contact the business to arrange slab viewing and confirm project timing.
